review_candidates.title: Cloud Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Responsibilities: Design, deploy, and maintain AWS network infrastructure across multiple accounts and regions, ensuring scalability, security, and reliability. Configure and troubleshoot BGP routing, including route advertisements, filtering, path selection, and routing policies. Collaborate with Systems, DevOps, Security, and cross-functional teams on infrastructure initiatives while maintaining accurate network documentation, architecture diagrams, and operational procedures. eligibility_evidence: About Us HFM is an internationally acclaimed multi-asset broker, delivering cutting-edge trading tools, platforms, and conditions to traders worldwide.
Design and implement resilient hybrid network architectures, ensuring high availability, redundancy, load balancing, and automated failover.
Experience with hybrid cloud connectivity, multi-region architectures, high availability, and network redundancy.

Benefits Hybrid Work Model (2 days working from home) Comprehensive Health Insurance Additional Paid Annual Leave Birthday Leave Meal Allowance Udemy Business access Referral Bonus Program Summer Short Fridays (August) Additional Support Visa Sponsorship and Relocation Assistance Sounds like you?
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements Must have: 3+ years of experience in a similar role. Strong hands-on experience with AWS networking, including Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, and VPC. Proficiency in Python, Bash, or other scripting languages, with experience in monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, VPC Flow Logs, and Reachability Analyzer.
